about: The fast (inventory) bridge between MOLI on Molibra and bMOLI on Ethereum: a hot wallet holds both and swaps one for the other in minutes. These are the numbers the bridge bot enforces (bots/fastbridge-core.mjs FAST_DEFAULTS); test/fastbridge.mjs checks they agree. Custodial for the minutes in flight; transfers outside the limits or above the inventory are not paid by the bot and go to the operator.
fee: 0.1-0.3% of the amount by how full the paying side of the inventory is (full at maxInventory), plus 1.2 x the payout's gas, rounded up to 0.01: /molibra/bridgefees.js fastFeeWei
